title: Claude Code skill researches 20-40 web pages and turns any topic into a cited audio course
summary: Courses on sites like Udemy are fixed and long. This skill has Claude research a topic across 20-40 web pages, compare where sources agree and disagree, and produce about 12 two-minute two-voice audio lessons, each with a summary card and citations.
agent_role: The agent maps sub-topics, researches and reads sources with reader agents, merges themes, plans and writes lessons, and generates audio. The human reviews one sample lesson before the rest are made.
outcome: The author says a 12-lesson course takes one long Claude Code session and yields about 25 minutes of audio.

curation.rationale: The multi-step research-to-audio workflow is clear and reproducible, with source checks and agent roles spelled out. However, the README shows no specific course built or result achieved, so it is borderline; the score includes a small education boost.
